title: How TXRF works: measuring metals on the wafer surface with total reflection [Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 5 Extra]
excerpt: An explanation of how TXRF (total reflection X-ray fluorescence) works. In this extra lesson for Cleaning Level 3, Lesson 5, learn how total reflection lets TXRF look only at the wafer surface to measure metal contamination, and get a rough idea of how small an amount of contamination it can find. You can also review key terms and common misconceptions.
